name: Sar Pass Trek

briefItinerary.title: Nagaru to Biskeri Thach via Sar Pass

itinerary.title: Kasol to Grahan Village
description: Arrive in Kasol, a charming town situated at an altitude of 1,700 meters in theParvati Valley. After an early breakfast, commence the trek to Grahan Village.Trekking distance covers 10 kilometers, taking approximately 4-6 hours.Traverse through dense forests adorned with Rhododendrons, Pine trees, andGolden oak. Enjoy the gradual ascent, soaking in the serene natural beautysurrounding the trail. Upon reaching Grahan Village, situated at an altitude of2,350 meters, set up camp and relish the peaceful mountain ambiance. Spendthe evening around a bonfire, sharing stories with fellow trekkers, andmarveling at the starlit sky.

itinerary.title: Grahan to Min Thach
itinerary.altitude: Min Thach 3,400 meters; altitude gain 1,050 meters
description: Embark on the trek to Min Thach after breakfast, covering a distance of 8kilometers with an altitude gain of 1,050 meters. The trail consists of achallenging ascent for the first 9 kilometers followed by a steep descent forthe final 1 kilometer. Trek through picturesque landscapes featuring lushmeadows and towering trees. Arrive at Min Thach, located at an altitude of3,400 meters, and set up camp amidst the expansive meadows. Take inbreathtaking views of snow-capped peaks and verdant valleys while enjoyinga well-deserved rest.

itinerary.title: Min Thach to Nagaru
description: Begin the day's trek to Nagaru, covering 6 kilometers. Navigate throughrugged terrain with continuous ascent, passing above the tree line into awindswept landscape. Note the absence of water sources along the way,ensuring to carry an adequate supply. Arrive at Nagaru, situated at an altitudeof 3,800 meters, offering panoramic vistas of snow-clad mountains and vastmeadows. Set up camp and experience the tranquility of the high-altitudewilderness.

itinerary.title: Nagaru to Biskeri Thach via Sar Pass
itinerary.altitude: Sar Pass summit 4,200 meters; Biskeri Thach 3,350 meters
description: Depart Nagaru for Biskeri Thach via Sar Pass, covering a distance of 14kilometers. Trek through challenging terrain, including a steep ascent on snowuntil reaching the majestic Sar Pass summit at an altitude of 4,200 meters.Marvel at the awe-inspiring sunrise and panoramic views of the Parvati Valleyand surrounding peaks. Enjoy a packed lunch amidst the breathtaking scenerybefore descending towards Biskeri Thach, situated at an altitude of 3,350meters. Settle into the final campsite on a picturesque meadow, savoring thelast night of the trek under the star-studded sky.

itinerary.title: Biskeri Thach - Pulga/Barshaini to Kasol
description: Bid farewell to Biskeri Thach and begin the descent towards Barshaini, covering a distance of 10 kilometers. Trek through lush forests and scenic trails. Arrive at Barshaini and conclude the trek, where transportation awaits for the journey back to Kasol. Reach Kasol by evening, concluding the memorable trekking expedition amidst the stunning landscapes of the Parvati Valley.

discrepancies: Day distances in the headers and body text disagree throughout: Day 1 header says 2 km trek, body says 10 km; Day 3 header says 5 km, body says 6 km; Day 4 header says 12 km, body says 14 km; Day 5 header says 6-7 km, body says 10 km. Header values are used for the trekDistance fields and body values retained in description.
Day 2 body says "a challenging ascent for the first 9 kilometers" within an 8 km day.
Day 1 body says the trek takes "approximately 4-6 hours"; the header says 1 hr.
Several body paragraphs have missing spaces between words (e.g. "theParvati Valley", "3,400 meters"), reproduced verbatim from the brochure.
